result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, my top recommendation would be **Xero Payroll or MYOB**, depending on your accounting setup and how many employees you have.

The important thing is choosing software that handles Australian payroll requirements, including Single Touch Payroll (STP), PAYG tax withholding, superannuation and award rates.

## My top 5 payroll software recommendations

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for Xero users)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- STP reporting and superannuation tools.
- Employee leave and pay management.
- Good for businesses wanting everything together.

Website: [Xero Australia](https://www.xero.com/au/)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for small businesses)

- Australian payroll compliance features.
- STP and superannuation.
- Employee payslips and leave management.
- Suitable for businesses wanting straightforward payroll.

Website: [MYOB Australia](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Reckon**

(Best for affordability)

- Payroll options for smaller teams.
- STP reporting.
- Superannuation management.
- Good option for keeping costs predictable.

Website: [Reckon Australia](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

![Employment Hero revenue, funding & news | Sacra](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/fzjrXPaeDGwbU0ktEn3_TQOhXXDHf36IZVXODrp9T7HoPtffJn3log8dcNXgqmxNTVoSA7Z8uruA7pqFNxyUEhGcStTX98s15F3_UqZVdwX3Hil0ScIjHbsYgq5CRV83FbCLkZXcqjEJTHBYwixjaLt2P4LznFNYwuYqYTuorQs3fGdTLjy3xRq6ouhsJUWG?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Employment Hero**

(Best for HR and payroll together)

- Payroll and employee records.
- Rostering and time tracking.
- Leave management.
- Useful as your workforce grows.

Website: [Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v2DxdxtjjvEmcT175Hs6YVBjgbAAlKMZDR6USs-77ApdWW6sbAFow9cQJv_MT97jB9zjE3wPxOpKSO9gcLLxLfFypeZvyP5eJvDL5WGyfBsSIqIhU81GbrWMoq4pqjRGs2-V3Eb0qoi-t3xsMSUPgetkp-nB9-Vn5YkmqvxZsrEUOfyJgwiq9_ZT3tLhuZte?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Payroller**

(Best for very small businesses)

- Simple payroll processing.
- STP reporting.
- Employee payslips.
- Particularly worth considering if you only have a handful of employees.

Website: [Payroller](https://payroller.com.au/)

These options are among the Australian payroll providers compared in 2026. [www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/australia-poor-nfp-cybersecurity/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which one would I choose?

| Business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 employees | Payroller |
| 5–15 employees | Xero or MYOB |
| 15–30 employees | Employment Hero |
| Rostering and shift workers | Employment Hero |
| Already use Xero accounting | Xero Payroll |
